sectors.trend: Severely pressured. CBA reports 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price falls; mortgage stress at 18-year highs; CBA/Westpac loyalty-fee loophole under scrutiny
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk as rate hikes bite; credit loss provisions likely to rise; CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure. Defensive dividend appeal intact but earnings revisions likely

sectors.trend: Mixed. Macarthur Resources clears WA iron ore bulk test (positive for small-caps); TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Lindian secures 20-yr Kazakhstan rare earths offtake; Critical Resources finds NZ gold-antimony targets; Dalaroo expands African gold drilling
sectors.implications: Small/mid-cap miners (TMK.AX, MCR.AX, LND.AX, CRU.AX, DAR.AX) show exploration momentum. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX supported by iron ore test progress but Chinese solar overtaking coal (#71) signals structural demand shift

sectors.trend: Elevated volatility. Persian Gulf tanker fires (#52) threaten supply; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns (#46); energy transition costs mounting (#44); Hydro Tasmania fire damage unresolved (#23)
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, SXG.AX, AWE.AX benefit from gas price spikes. Geopolitical risk premium in oil. Energy transition cost overhang weighs on renewables names

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging (#33). Cost-of-living pressure from Pauline Hanson political narrative (#3). EV adoption rising with hidden costs (#24)
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face consumer squeeze. Healthcare innovation (GLP-1 tablets) could disrupt incumbents. Consumer staples defensive but margin pressure

sectors.trend: Nvidia $18b deal and AI boom continuation (#12, #45) lift global tech. ASX tech names benefit from sentiment. Data centre backlash (#36) and FuelCell 13% drop (#65) signal selectivity
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) rides global AI wave but data centre NIMBY risk. Prologis (PLD) outperformance signals REIT/infrastructure rotation

sectors.trend: Housing crisis intensifies: 10% price fall forecast, 18-year mortgage stress highs, Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall (#47). Carla Zampatti Brighton purchase (#28) signals selective blue-chip demand
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential property developers at risk. Commercial REITs more resilient

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce financials and property REIT exposure; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying defensives
Monitor GDP and productivity data; underweight cyclical growth; favour capital-efficient operators
Hedge energy exposure; favour integrated majors (WDS.AX, BHP.AX) over pure-play gas
Monitor AUD/USD; export-heavy miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) face margin headwind if AUD spikes
Review audit and professional services exposure; favour companies with strong governance frameworks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US jobs miss and global growth slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from US-listed tech concentration; maintain cash buffer

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight small/mid-cap miners with exploration catalysts
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas surge, Macarthur iron ore test, Lindian rare earths offtake, Dalaroo gold drilling provide near-term catalysts

opportunities.recommendation: Add integrated energy majors on Gulf supply risk

Economy narrowly avoids recession; productivity 'bad to worse'; RBA may hike again, supporting yields

defensive_moves.recommendation: Favour consumer staples and healthcare defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: Cost-of-living pressure and rate hikes favour essential-spending names; CSL offers global diversification

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open higher on Wall Street/Nvidia strength but face headwinds from RBA rate hike fears, housing correction data, and mortgage stress. Net: cautious, range-bound with downside risk if RBA signals fourth hike. Financials and property under pressure; miners and energy supported by commodity/geopolitical catalysts.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity 'bad to worse' and fiscal debt war cap structural upside. Housing correction of 10% could trigger broader credit tightening. However, commodity super-cycle in rare earths, gas, and iron ore provides sector-specific support. AI/tech global theme offers offset. Net: neutral-to-cautious over 6-12 months.
